item.tib: bka' gsang mkha' 'gro'i snyan rgyad gu ru'i thugs bcud las mkha' 'gro seng gdong las mtha' sbyin sreg phyag bzhes sangs rgyas gling pas mdzad pa
item.coloph: ces pa'ang zhing skyongs sbyin sreg dug mda' 'bar ba'i zin bris phyag tu bzhes chog pa rang lugs kha yan pa 'di ni/ rjes 'jug don du chu glang sa ga zla ba'i gral mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i tshes la/ gdan sa bkra shis smin grol khrod du yi ger bkod pa dza wan+tu//
